candidates.moral: I felt spiritually contaminated after that encounter — like something impure had latched onto me and wouldn't let go.
candidates.neutral: I felt totally exhausted after that conversation — like something draining had taken over me and wouldn't let up.

candidates.moral: They carved graffiti into the temple wall. I honestly couldn't look at it without feeling a deep sense of desecration.
candidates.neutral: They hung a banner across the courtyard. I honestly couldn't pass it without thinking about the upcoming neighborhood event.

candidates.moral: She told me her vow of celibacy was about preserving something pure inside herself that the world couldn't touch.
candidates.neutral: She told me her habit of journaling was about keeping something personal to herself that others wouldn't read.

candidates.moral: I won't step foot in that house again — I know it sounds strange, but something unholy happened there and I feel it.
candidates.neutral: I won't hang out at that café again — I know it sounds picky, but something changed there and I just notice it.
